researchSources.title: Cape Cod National Seashore Visitor Centers
researchSources.translation: Orientation desk, trip planning, exhibits, film, store, restrooms, accessible media and outdoor observation should read as one coherent visitor sequence.

researchSources.title: Wayside Exhibit Planning
researchSources.publisher: U.S. National Park Service, Harpers Ferry Center
researchSources.translation: Put orientation information at the moment a visitor needs it and coordinate it with site views and the broader media plan.

researchSources.title: Commercial coworking
researchSources.translation: Mix open and reservable workspaces, reservable offices, conference rooms, shared kitchen, restrooms and support.

researchSources.title: Facilities standards for the Public Buildings Service — 2024 P100
researchSources.translation: Treat accessibility, architecture, structure, fire protection, building enclosure and MEP as coordinated disciplines, not isolated decoration.

researchSources.title: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design
researchSources.translation: Connect arrival, every occupied level and amenities with continuous accessible routes; provide accessible pool and spa entry.

researchSources.title: About the Model Aquatic Health Code
researchSources.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
researchSources.translation: Pool and hot-tub design must include construction, operations, maintenance, staff and water-quality planning.

researchSources.title: 1910.36 Design and construction requirements for exit routes
researchSources.publisher: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
researchSources.translation: Provide remote permanent exit routes, adequate capacity, direct discharge and unobstructed operation.

researchSources.title: 1910.29 Fall protection systems and falling object protection
researchSources.publisher: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
researchSources.translation: Occupied roof edges, stairs, openings and elevated work areas need deliberate guard and fall-protection design.

researchSources.title: Extensive Vegetative Roofs
researchSources.translation: A roof garden requires coordinated waterproofing, protection, drainage, root barrier, growing medium and wind/load review.

researchSources.title: Integrity Testing for Roofing and Waterproofing Membranes
researchSources.translation: Water testing itself can impose unsafe load or cause damage; divide, control and plan water tests before filling.

atomicReleaseSequence: Create a fresh immutable same-moment snapshot and database hash; abort on drift.
Capture matched before media for façades, both floors, roof, existing stair, all 15 block entities, west lounge parcel and staff-path endpoint.
Re-census B01 and a two-block neighbor buffer for states, fluids, gravity cells, block entities, entities and protected features.
Generate an exact support/core transaction and exact inverse. Do not include water, pool, hot tubs, bars or room fitout.
Preflight every support and core cell against the immutable snapshot; resolve all existing-room and furniture conflicts by reviewed migration.
Execute support and core transaction atomically, then snapshot and independently verify vertical routes and the load-path contract.
Release dry upper shells and roof enclosure as a second atomic transaction; verify weather and fall containment.
Coordinate and accept the employee lounge/greenway package, then open the B01 staff connection under exact guards.
Release dry floor fitouts, including the separated adult suite shells, without any water.
Build empty pool and hot-tub basins, plant rooms, catch zones and drains; complete empty-basin and rollback QA.
Place water last as its own bounded transaction with immediate isolation and rollback available.
Run bidirectional normal-walk QA for every public, staff, accessible and emergency route; verify doors, guards, sightlines and privacy vestibules.
Capture matched after media and import child features only after the final post snapshot passes.
Keep the original B01 database feature and all source artifacts until reconciliation proves every accepted new feature and rollback.
releaseGates: No live command is authorized by this artifact.
No occupied upper floor or water until the support transaction independently passes.
No destructive operation on the 15 protected block entities without NBT-preserving migration and rollback.

No water source placement before dry double-basin acceptance.
No privacy or age-control door may obstruct emergency egress.

No database status change from complete to superseded until post-release reconciliation.
